<translate>

<translate>
== Getting it ==

Tamagami Number 3 drops it 30% of the time by default when defeated (see [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]]).
</translate>

<translate>

* '''Moveset:''' mace, slow, heavy blows.
* It has 2,800 durability.
